correctness.rationale: For k=2,3,4 the exact marginal over the Poisson product has log correction [-s(s-1)/(2λ)+ks-k²λ/2]/n. Exponentiation on s≤n^(1/8) leaves O((1+s)^4/n²); bounded-mean binomial and Poisson exponential moments control the weighted tails beyond that cutoff and give O(n^-2) in polynomially bounded expectations uniformly on compact positive intensities. In the disjoint covariance, r_4(s+t)-r_2(s)-r_2(t)=-(s-2λ)(t-2λ)/λ, giving -c²/(λn)+O(n^-2). The exact diagonal moment is 2λ, adjacent Poisson covariance is τ-μ², and the numbers of pairs give the uniform O(1) total residual. The score identity c=λμ′ and the Bessel recurrences yield c=2λ exp(-2λ)I_0(2λ). Orthogonal decomposition leaves a positive degenerate-kernel component (the 0,1 mixed difference is -2). Expanding the terms with counts 0 through 3 gives τ=λ+2λ³+O(λ⁴), μ=2λ-2λ²+2λ³+O(λ⁴), and c²/λ=4λ-16λ²+40λ³+O(λ⁴). At high intensity, bounded scaled fourth moments justify taking the absolute-product moment of the Gaussian contrasts of adjacent correlation -1/2, giving the stated coefficient. These are two limits of v only. The frozen checker and its output were inspected, not executed; their finite corroboration is not the proof.
residual_risks: No uniformity is established as N/n approaches zero or infinity; neither endpoint claim asserts such uniformity.
